note: vespera-bridge: a wire request between Integer.MAX_VALUE - 8 and Integer.MAX_VALUE bytes is rejected with the IllegalArgumentException (use streaming dispatch) instead of an OutOfMemoryError. The servlet proxy rejects a declared Content-Length at the 2 GiB single-array bound before reading it, with a 413 that names the built-in bound. README documents the 64 MiB cap on streaming channel slots. Test and doc fixes for the streaming-pool, oversize-policy, read-only encode, GraalVM metadata, child-JVM timeout and demo-app chunk sizing checks.
